subject: Hospitality
title: Contactless Check-In and Digital Keys
description: Learn Contactless Check-In and Digital Keys in one minute.

hook.text: The front desk may disappear. Guests now check in on their phones and unlock rooms with digital keys.

buildup.text: Mobile check-in surged during COVID-19 when physical contact became a health concern for travelers.

discovery.text: Marriott, Hilton, and Hyatt all launched mobile key apps. Guests bypass the lobby entirely and go straight to their room.

twist.text: But many luxury guests still want a human greeting. The front desk is evolving into a concierge, not vanishing.

climax.text: The future desk is optional—tech for speed, humans for warmth. Both coexist by guest choice.

punchline.text: Skip the line or savor the welcome. Technology makes it your call.

quiz.question: What accelerated mobile check-in adoption in hotels?
options: COVID-19 and health concerns about physical contact
